title: January mein Earth Sun ke sabse PAAS hoti hai
description: Season 2 Episode 4: Seasons come from Earth's tilt, not distance — and Earth speeds up when it's closest to the Sun (Kepler's 2nd law).
exam_focus: JEE/NEET: Kepler's 2nd law, areal velocity, ellipse orbits
hook_text: January = Earth Sun ke SABSE PAAS. Phir thand kyun? ❄️
concept: Seasons come from Earth's tilt, not distance — and Earth speeds up when it's closest to the Sun (Kepler's 2nd law).
on_screen_cues: "3 Jan: 147 million km · 4 Jul: 152 million km" → "Tilt 23.5°" → ellipse with fast/slow arrows → "Kepler 2nd law: equal area in equal time · NCERT XI Ch 7"
pinned_comment: Agar Earth ka tilt ZERO ho jaaye toh seasons hote? Comment karo 🌍
suggested_titles: "January mein Earth Sun ke sabse paas hoti hai 🤯" / "Thand distance se nahi hoti! Kepler ka law"
elevenlabs_script:
Gudiya: [confidently] Chintu, January mein thand hoti hai kyunki Earth Sun se door hoti hai. Right?
Chintu: [deadpan] Wrong!
Gudiya: [sighs] Phir se wrong?!
Chintu: [excited] January mein Earth Sun ke SABSE PAAS hoti hai! 3 January ke aas paas!
Gudiya: [confused] Sabse paas?! Toh thand kyun?!
Chintu: [cheerfully] Kyunki seasons distance se nahi, Earth ke TILT se hote hain! Earth 23 and a half degree tirchi hai. January mein hamara hissa Sun se door jhuka hota hai.
Gudiya: [thoughtful] Toh Australia mein January mein garmi?
Chintu: [excited] Exactly! Unka hissa Sun ki taraf jhuka hai!
Gudiya: [curious] Aur Earth ka orbit gol nahi hai?
Chintu: [mischievously] Thoda anda jaisa hai. ELLIPSE. Aur yahan ek twist hai...
Gudiya: [curious] Kya?
Chintu: [dramatic tone] Sun ke paas Earth TEZ chalti hai, door jaake SLOW ho jaati hai!
Gudiya: [gasps] Speed badalti hai?!
Chintu: [excited] Haan! Isliye hamara winter, summer se almost 5 din CHHOTA hota hai!
Gudiya: [elated] Matlab Earth Sun ke paas jaake speed up karti hai... jaise slide pe neeche aate hue!
Chintu: [proudly] Exactly! Kepler ka second law. 400 saal purana.
Gudiya: [curious] Chalo ab space se zameen pe. Ek bhaari cheez aur ek halki cheez... kaun pehle girti hai?
Chintu: [mischievously] Woh next video mein!
